name: Dragonborn
description: Born of dragons, as their name proclaims, dragonborn walk proudly through a world that greets them with fearful incomprehension. Shaped by draconic gods or the dragons themselves, dragonborn originally hatched from dragon eggs as a unique race, combining the best attributes of dragons and humanoids.

grants.name: Draconic Ancestry
grants.description: Choose the type of dragon you descend from. It determines the damage type and shape of your Breath Weapon and the damage type of your resistance.

options.name: Black
options.description: Acid damage — Breath Weapon: 5 ft. by 30 ft. line (Dexterity save).

options.name: Blue
options.description: Lightning damage — Breath Weapon: 5 ft. by 30 ft. line (Dexterity save).

options.name: Brass

grants.name: Breath Weapon
grants.description: Action: exhale destructive energy in the shape and damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity or Constitution save (as appropriate), taking damage that scales with your level on a failure, half as much on a success. Usable a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses on a long rest.

grants.name: Damage Resistance
grants.description: Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry.
